use_case_name: Decorrelate Diverging Air or Surface Tracks

claims.content: To decorrelate diverging air or surface tracks when a C2 JU determines that two previously correlated tracks are no longer the same track.

goal.raw_text: To decorrelate diverging air or surface tracks when a C2 JU determines that two previously correlated tracks are no longer the same track.

claims.content: C2 JU
Two tracks (air or surface) have been previously correlated by the C2 JU.
The C2 JU has determined that the two previously correlated tracks are no longer the same track (i.e., they are diverging).
The C2 JU is capable of automatically initiating and deactivating track correlation capabilities without operator action, as required for real-time track reporting and difference resolution.
A C2 JU determines that two previously correlated air or surface tracks are no longer the same track (i.e., they are diverging).

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU determines that two previously correlated air or surface tracks are no longer the same track (i.e., they are diverging).

claims.content: If the C2 JU holds locally derived data for Platform, Platform Activity, or Specific Type fields that differ from the values accepted for retransmission, it shall report the locally derived data instead of retransmitting the previously correlated track identity.
If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1 for either diverging track, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R², regardless of locally derived data.

For real-time tracks, the position reported after decorrelation shall be extrapolated to the time of transmission; for nonreal-time tracks, positions shall not be extrapolated and must include time tags.
Velocity (course and speed) for air or surface tracks shall be reported in data miles per hour of ground speed and degrees with respect to true north.
Tracking Data including Latitude, Longitude, Altitude/Elevation/Depth, Course, Speed, Minute, Hour, and Track Quality shall be provided for each decorrelated track if applicable.
If the C2 JU is deactivating a receive filter, it shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.
The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks after achieving Active status or returning from Inactive status or TDS Failure is 12 seconds; for land tracks, it is 48 seconds.
Under conditions where nonreal-time tracks are irregularly reported, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.

When an Air Platform value of 6 (Tanker), 7 (Tanker Boom Only), or 8 (Tanker Drogue Only) is held locally and a different value is received during difference resolution, an operator alert in this situation is optional.
The diverging air or surface tracks are reported as separate entities with their respective Environment/Category, Identity, and Exercise Indicator values resolved.

A J3.X or J7.0 (ACT = 1) message is generated containing the appropriate evaluation of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields for the decorrelated tracks.

If the C2 JU accepted a remote ID change during the resolution, it retains the received values of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields for retransmission.
For each decorrelated real-time track, the position is reported extrapolated to the time of transmission.
For any decorrelated nonreal-time track, the data is identified as such, time tags are provided, and the track position is not extrapolated.
Tracking Data including Latitude, Longitude, Altitude/Elevation/Depth, Course, Speed, Minute, Hour, and Track Quality is included in the report for the decorrelated tracks.
